description: React component implementing a development user interface for authentication and API testing in a data asset management system. Provides login, logout, theme toggle, and API call functionalities with status display.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React functional component managing theme, authentication, and API interactions.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Switches between light and dark themes.

methods.name: doFetch
methods.description: Performs fetch requests with proper headers, handles response, updates status.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Logs in a user by requesting a JWT token from the backend.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears authentication token and updates UI to logged out state.
